reason: React Radix/Base UI migration advice is inapplicable; the port documents runtime-selected Solid/Kobalte compatibility.

upstream.text: The components are built on Base UI, and the CLI installs @base-ui/react next to Radix. Your own components keep Radix; only the audiocn files import Base UI. A few things to know:

channel-strip uses the shadcn badge. If you have customised yours, answer No when the CLI asks to overwrite badge.tsx. The current shadcn badge also adds the cn package; remove it from package.json if you keep your own badge.
audio-device-select and the blocks compose shadcn components through Base UI APIs (render, the Select items prop), so they need a Base UI project. Every other item works in both.
The six audio tokens land in your global CSS. If your theme already has status colours, point the tokens at them instead (see Theming).
The code compiles against an ES2022 lib.

local.text: The two registry URLs expose the same public audiocn API. The Solid 1 registry targets Solid 1.9.15+ and the Solid 1 Kobalte line. The Solid 2 registry targets Solid 2 and the Solid 2 Kobalte line. Runtime-specific compatibility files are selected when the registry is built; application code should not branch on the Solid version.
The six audio tokens land in your global CSS. If your theme already has status colours, point the tokens at them instead (see Theming).
